posts.author: cactusJed
posts.body:
Hi, everyone.
I'm a traditional developer (PHP and other languages) by my job in the UK, but a hobbyist in what little spare time I have for my love of RPGs. I used to write pen and paper RPGs with hundreds of sheets of battle systems as a kid.
In between looking after 2 young children and watching tennis, i am always writing notes about what I'd put into a game.
I've dabbled many years ago with RPG Maker VX, but now I want to take it a bit more seriously, and have joined the MZ world. Progress will be slow, but it will be progress.
I am aware I need to spend time reading the forums and understanding the engine, also to do shorter demo projects rather than leaping into one big one. However, I'm more of a "build a proof of concept" kind of guy. I enjoy planning out storyboards, mind-mapping and the like. I'll get there, eventually.
Hope to learn a lot while I'm here!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the cult! The RPG Maker God is pleased to have another supplicant!
Your prior experience will be a big help. I was totally new to everything when I started about 2.5 years ago. But I haven’t regretted a single moment.
This is a great place to get help, find resources, and generally socialize.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
